The OP billing service is a module designed to serve as a centralized billing point for all outpatient (OP) services provided by hospitals. It is capable of generating various bill charges tailored to different patient types based on specific eligibility criteria. Additionally, the system allows for the re-printing of all OP service bills. The billing process is primarily conducted through the Service Billing Advanced form, which facilitates most billing activities within the hospital setting. This comprehensive approach ensures efficient management of outpatient billing operations.
